articles.title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
articles.description:
"That was her big lesson for me: that after loss, I could find happiness again. She wanted me to avoid getting stuck in a miserable moment that had passed."

The post I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much  appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Margo emphasized the importance of balancing grief and happiness after loss.
The article reflects on personal lessons learned from Margo's friendship.
Boston residents can find inspiration in Margo's approach to coping with grief.
